subject: microbiology
title: Rickettsia, Chlamydia and Mycoplasma

steps.tx: **Rickettsiae** (obligate intracellular, Weil-Felix cross reaction with **Proteus OX19, OX2 and OXK** strains) ride arthropods: epidemic typhus (Pediculus lice, Brill-Zinsser recrudescence years later), murine typhus (flea OX19), Rocky Mountain spotted fever (Dermacentor tick, rash from **wrists and ankles inward including palms and soles**), with **doxycycline** treating all (even children under 8 in RMSF, benefit outweighs staining). Rash with fever after tick exposure in forests demands doxy before confirmation; chloramphenicol is second line.
steps.say: Tick bite fever with wrist to trunk rash is spotted fever: doxy now. OXK points to scrub.

steps.tx: **Scrub typhus** (Orientia tsutsugamushi, chigger mite, **eschar** cigarette burn ulcer with regional nodes, forest and scrub exposure across the tsutsugamushi triangle) causes fever with hepatitis-like transaminases, pneumonitis and meningoencephalitis; **Q fever** (Coxiella burnetii, parturition products and dust, no vector, phase I virulent) causes atypical pneumonia with granulomatous hepatitis and **culture negative endocarditis**. Doxycycline cures both; Q fever endocarditis needs doxy plus hydroxychloroquine for 18 months with phase I titres followed.
steps.say: Cigarette burn eschar with forest fever is scrub typhus. Abattoir dust pneumonia with high phase I is Q fever.

steps.tx: **Chlamydia** (obligate intracellular, **elementary body** infectious extracellular versus **reticulate body** replicating intracellular) types by disease: **trachomatis A to C** (trachoma,SAFE strategy: surgery, antibiotics, face washing, environment), **D to K** (inclusion conjunctivitis, NGU, cervicitis, PID), **L1 to L3** (**LGV**, groove sign with inguinal and femoral nodes, rectal strictures). **Psittaci** (birds, atypical pneumonia) and **pneumoniae** (walking pneumonia, TWAR) complete the set. **NAAT** diagnoses genital disease; single dose **azithromycin** or doxycycline treats with partner therapy.
steps.say: Groove sign nodes with rectal stricture is LGV. SAFE fights trachoma; NAAT names genital chlamydia.

steps.tx: **Mycoplasma pneumoniae** (no cell wall, no Gram stain, beta lactam resistant, **fried egg colonies** needing sterols, Eaton agent) causes **walking pneumonia** in schoolchildren (dry cough, patchy infiltrates, **bullous myringitis**, **cold agglutinins** with haemolysis, Stevens-Johnson, transverse myelitis) treated with **macrolides or doxycycline**. **M. genitalium** (NGU, azithromycin with moxifloxacin backup as resistance spreads) and **Ureaplasma** (neonatal, urease splitting) need NAAT as culture is too slow. Wall less forms (L forms) persist after beta lactams.
steps.say: Schoolchild walking pneumonia with ear bullae and cold agglutinins is Mycoplasma: macrolide, never beta lactam.
